[[File:Matthew Clemans DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Sealed Deck at [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Matthew Clemans''' (also published as '''Matt Clemans''' and '''Matt Clemens'''; DeckTech handle '''FridayKnight''')<ref name="dt-141">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/141 Another Tatooine Deck], DeckTech (Matthew "FridayKnight" Clemans, 17 August 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/141/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/141/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018232324/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/141/ Wayback Machine].</ref> was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 107 from Danville, Kentucky.<ref name="sm-fan" />

A Centre College student, he started the Kentucky tournament scene in fall 1998.<ref name="decsq-prof" /> He posted a [[Dark]] [[Tatooine Occupation]] list on DeckTech in August 1999.<ref name="dt-141" /> At the [[2000 Death Star II Pre-Release (Normal)]] in Normal, Illinois, on 24 June 2000, David Marincic's report names him as a Squadron Member from Kentucky.<ref name="tr-d944" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
I started playing Star Wars CCG in 1995, right when the game first came out. I remember, I got the [[Millennium Falcon]] in my first starter deck.

I found out that there was no local playing scene within several hours of me - so I decided to create one!<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
